about: A combined Pledge lays its condition with the hit, before the target it fells faints (0b389990a: before, 'fainted!' came first, as seen in round 9). The Twins' double battle in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with a level-30 Pawmot and a level-30 Baxcalibur on the twins' platform, given Fire Pledge and Grass Pledge in the running battle (teach:), the foes only Splash. The Pawmot waits for the Baxcalibur's Pledge, which becomes the combined move, fells the Spinarak and lays the sea of fire first; the Ledyba, set to 1 HP, is burnt down by the sea of fire at the turn's end.

lines: Pawmot is waiting for Baxcalibur’s move...
The two moves have become one! It’s a combined move!
A sea of fire enveloped the opposing team!
The opposing Ledyba is hurt by the sea of fire!
